title: 牛津上海 六年级下册

examples.zh: 我有一个短袖圆领汗衫。

examples.en: I like it. However, it is small.
We eat moon cakes in autumn.
I go there once a week.
The bus stops in front of the school.

examples.zh: 我有一个[机]套筒，[机]套管。

examples.en: There are trees around the house.

examples.zh: 蛋糕是备有空调装置的。
我有一个单层公共汽车。

examples.en: None of the cups is broken.
I walk instead of taking a bus.
The desk is made of wood.
